log.msg: The X was never pinned right: `.dev-hint { margin-inline-end: auto }` sat in @layer theme, and `.flex > * { margin: 0 }` in @layer util (framework.css:374) zeroes it — a later layer beats any specificity. Same trap `.measure` works around. Fixed with `flex-grow: 1` on the hint, which is not a margin.

Measured in the live tab: head one row with zero overflow at 832 / 272 / 240px rail; at the 200px floor the hint wraps to 57px rather than clipping. X right edge == head content edge at every width. Checkbox round-trips window.$BLOCKRELOAD true/false.

assign.outcome: **`block` checkbox in the dev rail head, and the ✕ finally pinned right** — /framework/dev/DevBar/. The checkbox writes `window.$BLOCKRELOAD` directly (Socket reads it live in `reload()` and `changed()`); deliberately NOT persisted through settings.js, since a block surviving a reload reads as live reload being broken. The ✕ was never right-aligned: the `margin-inline-end: auto` on `.dev-hint` was dead — `.flex > * { margin: 0 }` in @layer util beats @layer theme at any specificity. Replaced with `flex-grow: 1`, which no layer zeroes. Both decisions recorded in readme.md; page.js documents the new control.
